description.en: Personal plugin market for the DeepSeek Harness: install plugins straight from GitHub repositories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的个人插件市场：直接从 GitHub 仓库安装插件。

description.en: Adds a QQ Bot section to the settings page: bind a QQ bot with a QR code inside the app, chat in private and group chats, and let the bot decide on its own whether to join a group conversation instead of waiting to be @-mentioned.
description.zh: 在设置页新增「QQ 机器人」分区：端内扫码绑定 QQ 机器人，把私聊与群聊接进 dsh；群里不用点名，她会自己判断该不该接话。
